description: This file contains a PHP trait named InstallerCommandHelperTrait that provides helper methods for console commands related to the installer in the OrangeHRM project. The methods include input validation, system check display, and step management during installation.

methods.name: getRequiredField
methods.description: Prompts the user for a required input with optional validation, returning the trimmed answer.

methods.name: requiredValidator
methods.description: Validates that the answer is not null or empty; throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: databasePortValidator
methods.description: Validates that the port number is within the acceptable range 0-65535.

methods.name: alphanumericValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: phoneNumberValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input is a valid phone number format.

methods.name: hasOption
methods.description: Checks if a command-line option is provided and non-empty.

methods.name: drawSystemCheckTable
methods.description: Displays a table summarizing system check results for the installer.

methods.name: startSection
methods.description: Starts a new console output section for process step indication.

methods.name: startStep
methods.description: Overwrites the current console section with the step label.

methods.name: completeStep
methods.description: Marks a process step as completed in the console output.

methods.name: validateStrLength
methods.description: Ensures string does not exceed specified maximum length.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Checks password strength and policy compliance, throwing an exception if policies are not met.
